name: TimezonePicker
description: A searchable timezone selection dropdown. Renders a filterable list of IANA timezone options with UTC offset display.

notes: The input supports type-ahead filtering of timezone options.
Arrow keys navigate through filtered options in the dropdown.
Escape closes the dropdown and returns focus to the input.
Selected timezone is announced via aria-selected on the active option.
Focus indicator uses a 2px solid outline with var(--color-border-focus).

value.description: The currently selected IANA timezone identifier (e.g. 'America/New_York').

onChange.description: Callback fired when a timezone is selected.

size.description: Controls the input height, padding, and font size.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the root wrapper element.

do: Always provide an accessible label via aria-label or a linked FormLabel.
Display the UTC offset alongside the timezone name for user clarity.
Pair with Datepicker and Timepicker for full date-time-zone selection.
dont: Do not use for simple UTC offset selection — this is for IANA timezone selection.
Do not omit a label — provide aria-label if no visible label is present.
